subsystems.name: The string itself
subsystems.role: the resource: a hypothetical one-dimensional defect left over from the early universe, thinner than a proton but with a mass of roughly a million billion tonnes per metre and tension approaching the speed-of-light limit.

subsystems.name: Detection and ranging
subsystems.role: you cannot harvest what you cannot find or track.

subsystems.name: Coupling structure
subsystems.role: the apparatus that converts the string's motion or stored current into usable electric current.

subsystems.name: Power conversion
subsystems.role: turns the raw induced current into a stable, exportable supply.

subsystems.name: Station keeping
subsystems.role: a cosmic string moves at a large fraction of light speed and would slice through anything in its path.

buildSteps.title: Establish that strings exist
buildSteps.detail: Cosmic strings are a prediction of certain symmetry-breaking scenarios in the early universe; some models have already been ruled out. Everything below is conditional on a confirmed detection.

buildSteps.title: Characterise a candidate
buildSteps.detail: Searches look for the string's signatures: sharp steps in the microwave background, tiny correlated timing shifts in pulsar signals, and gravitational-wave bursts from string loops. A confirmed candidate would need its tension, velocity and distance measured.

buildSteps.title: Calculate the energy budget
buildSteps.detail: Work out how much energy passes a given point per second. Analytic work suggests strings and string loops carry real energy, some of it radiated as gravitational waves by oscillating loops — but no published scheme has shown net positive extraction in a realistic geometry.

buildSteps.title: Model a coupling apparatus
buildSteps.detail: Simulate whether a conductor or magnetic array placed near a moving string would pick up useful induced current, or whether energy could be tapped from gravitational effects. This is the step that has not been done convincingly; a design that loses more than it collects ends the project.

buildSteps.title: Engineer the harvester
buildSteps.detail: By analogy with terrestrial generators, this means very large superconducting coils, cryogenic cooling in space, and structural support held clear of the string's path.

buildSteps.title: Convert and export
buildSteps.detail: Induced current is rectified and stabilised, then beamed or cabled towards where it is used. Pulsed, unpredictable output would demand enormous buffering.

buildSteps.title: Test for net gain
buildSteps.detail: Run a small prototype, measure energy returned against the energy spent on cooling, propulsion and beaming, and only then scale up.

prerequisites.why: if they do not exist, there is nothing to harvest.
current and planned detectors are the main instruments that could reveal string signatures.
any electromagnetic pick-up would depend on large, cryogenically cooled coils.
no published mechanism has shown net positive work from a cosmic string.
the apparatus would operate far beyond Earth's orbit, unreachable for repair.

pathway.unlocks: the first concrete energy-budget calculation for a specific object.
